title: Unforgettable experience
text:
Fantastic trip,where was taken into account everyone's ride level 
From beginner to experienced rider.
We were picked up in Seville by the knight teacher who drove us to the place where the horses were ready for us
We ride in beautiful surroundings.
There was a mess with our meeting place, it got the office fixed quickly
A place we can warmly recommend
author: tinajensen11

title: Knowledge, and wonderful horses!
text: This was amazing! We had Patricia and her wonderful spirit and passion for Doñana National Park was absolutely the best! And I fell in love with my horse Cameron. The horses had the best temper. I’ll definitely be back🐴♥️

title: Horse riding trek
text: The guide was super lovely, the horses were really well looked after, and the school was such a great environment! Definitely recommend
author: Caitlin_s

title: Highly recommend Patricia!
text: Patricia was an excellent guide. She explained everything well, she was on time and fun to be around. She was enthusiastic and made sure everyone was safe, especially myself as a first time rider. The scenery was absolutely gorgeous and was enthusiastic. I recommend this your tour to anyone visiting Seville. Thank you Patricia for making this a memorable moment. You are the best!
author: Jennifer P

title: Visiting Seville
text: One of the best experiences riding the horses with our guide Patricia, she was helpful with a lots of information regarding the Doñana park.
author: Ramon P

title: Well worth it
text: Brillant from pick up , lovely relaxed drive ,with a very knowlegeble polite driver .Horses were super ,owner was a cool guy ,great trek in beautifull countryside, I will be Back.
author: Gasman2022

title: Andalucian equestrian adventure!
text: What fun it was to get to explore some of the beautiful Andalucian countryside on an Arab/Andalucian Cross. Having once gone to Iceland to ride an Icelandic horse, this opportunity was too good to pass up!
author: GrandTour426723

title: Wonderful horse ride
text: We did a guided horse ride with Patricia from Naturanda which was very nice! Patricia took us for two hours through the Doñana which is a beautiful environment. Patricia told us al lot about the animals and plants. My boyfriend even saw a lynx. We had the perfect day for the horse ride with a very friendly guide.
